title: Strategy Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Strategy Inc (MSTR) filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing ATM equity offering sales and bitcoin purchases for the period April 13–19, 2026. The company sold 2.165 million MSTR shares for $366 million in net proceeds and 21.8 million STRC preferred shares for $2.176 billion. It acquired 34,164 BTC at an average price of $74,395 using proceeds from the ATM sales. Total BTC holdings stand at 815,061 BTC with an average cost basis of $75,527 and aggregate purchase price of $61.56 billion.
